unit_title: ምዕራፍ ፩ — Meraf 1: Grand Master of ሀ and ለ

success_screen.headline_en: Spectacular! You are the Grand Master of ሀ and ለ!
success_screen.headline_am: ግሩም ድንቅ ነው! የሀ እና ለ የደረጃ ፫ ዋና ጠቢብ ሆኑ!

games.title: Grand Decoder: HAHU
games.instructions_en: Match the native English phonetic spelling 'HAHU' (Amharic Alphabet) with the correct Amharic word counterpart.

games.title: Grand Finish: ሎሚ
games.instructions_en: Look closely at the word 'Lemon' (Lomi). Find the correct missing first-form related letter: [ ? ]ሚ.
games.tips_en: The full word is ሎሚ (pronounced Lo-mi).

games.title: Master Sequence Check
games.instructions_en: Grand Master skip pattern! Look at the pattern: 1st form ➔ 3rd form ➔ 5th form ➔ [ ? ] (7th form). What goes next?

games.title: Grand Builder: ሌሊት
games.instructions_en: Assemble the letters correctly to spell the Amharic word for Night (Lelit) without clues!
games.tips_en: Tip: Start with 5th form 'ሌ', follow with 3rd form 'ሊ', and end in 6th form 'ት'!

games.title: Grand Decoder: LOMI
games.instructions_en: Match the native English phonetic spelling 'LOMI' (Lemon) with the correct Amharic word counterpart.

games.title: Grand Audio Blend: ል
games.instructions_en: Listen closely in your head to the light, breathy native 6th form 'L' sound. Which symbol matches this silent form?

games.title: Grand Builder: ሀገር
games.instructions_en: Form the full Amharic word for Country or Nation (Hager)!
games.tips_en: Tip: Select 1st form 'ሀ', then 1st form 'ገ', and end with 6th form 'ር'!

games.title: Grand Decoder: HAGER
games.instructions_en: Match the native English phonetic spelling 'HAGER' (Country/Nation) with the correct Amharic word counterpart.
